# CoherynUI — Comprehensive LLM Architecture, API & Protocol Specification

> Authoritative machine-readable reference for frontier AI models and coding agents operating within CoherynUI projects.
> Release Target: Stable 1.0 (COH-AMD-1.1, COH-AMD-1.2, COH-AMD-1.3)
> Schema Version: 1.0.0
> Canonical Layer & Variable Prefix: `cyn`

---

## 1. Executive Product Identity & Architecture

- **Framework Name**: CoherynUI (always uppercase 'C' and 'UI', never separated with whitespace and never unadorned without UI/CSS suffix).
- **CSS Engine**: Coheryn CSS Engine.
- **CLI Binary**: `coherynui`.
- **Runtime Model**: Zero mandatory browser JavaScript for styling. All layout, design tokens, color modes, and container queries compile to standards-compliant, W3C-layered CSS.
- **Optional Client Runtimes**: Tree-shakeable, opt-in packages:
  - `@coherynui/react`: Accessible WAI-ARIA React components.
  - `@coherynui/components`: Headless UI logic & state machines.
  - `@coherynui/motion`: Analytical spring dynamics and FLIP transitions.
  - `@coherynui/gpu-materials`: WebGPU WGSL optical refraction shaders.
  - `@coherynui/tokens`: Design tokens and theme custom properties.

---

## 2. Cascade Layer Architecture

All CSS output generated by CoherynUI is strictly ordered across five explicit `@layer` declarations:

```css
@layer cyn.reset, cyn.tokens, cyn.base, cyn.recipes, cyn.utilities;
```

### Precedence Hierarchy (Lowest to Highest Specificity)
1. `cyn.reset`: Box-sizing resets, zeroed margins/paddings, media defaults.
2. `cyn.tokens`: CSS custom properties (`--cyn-*`) bound to `:root` and `[data-theme="..."]`.
3. `cyn.base`: Base element typography, body background, and font families.
4. `cyn.recipes`: Composite component layouts (`.stack`, `.sidebar`, `.glass`, `.btn-primary`).
5. `cyn.utilities`: Single-purpose utility rules (`.text-brand`, `.flex-between`). Utilities always win over recipe declarations due to cascade layer ordering, regardless of source order.

### Prefix Customization
Prefixes are customizable in `coherynui.config.toml`:
```toml
[compiler]
layer_prefix = "cyn"      # Sets @layer <prefix>.*
variable_prefix = "cyn"   # Sets --<prefix>-*
class_prefix = ""         # Optional utility class prefix
```

---

## 3. CLI Command Matrix & Exit Codes

```bash
# Compilation & Development
coherynui build --input . --output coherynui.css [--minify] [--target modern|compat]
coherynui dev [--port 3000] [--open]

# Verification & Inspection
coherynui check [--format text|json]
coherynui explain "<classes>"
coherynui analyze [--format json]

# AI Agent Integration
coherynui agent init [--dry-run]
coherynui agent doctor
coherynui agent skills list
coherynui agent skills install [--target-dir <dir>]

# Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
coherynui mcp serve [--transport stdio]
coherynui mcp doctor
```

### Exit Codes
- `0`: Success, zero diagnostic errors.
- `1`: Syntax or compilation error.
- `2`: Accessibility or diagnostic contract failure (`coherynui check`).
- `3`: Configuration parsing failure.

---

## 4. Design System Tokens Matrix (`--cyn-*`)

### Colors (Semantic & State)
| Token Name | Default (Dark) | Default (Light) | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cyn-color-surface` | `#0f172a` | `#f8fafc` | Deepest canvas background |
| `--cyn-color-surface-elevated` | `#1e293b` | `#ffffff` | Card, dialog, popover surface |
| `--cyn-color-surface-subtle` | `#334155` | `#e2e8f0` | Input backgrounds, active tab tracks |
| `--cyn-color-foreground` | `#f8fafc` | `#0f172a` | Primary text and headings |
| `--cyn-color-muted` | `#94a3b8` | `#64748b` | Secondary captions, subheadings |
| `--cyn-color-border` | `#334155` | `#e2e8f0` | Structural dividers and borders |
| `--cyn-color-brand` | `#6366f1` | `#4f46e5` | Primary interactive brand color |
| `--cyn-color-brand-hover` | `#4f46e5` | `#4338ca` | Hover state for primary buttons |
| `--cyn-color-brand-contrast` | `#ffffff` | `#ffffff` | Accessible foreground on brand |
| `--cyn-color-accent` | `#38bdf8` | `#0284c7` | Secondary highlighting |
| `--cyn-color-success` | `#10b981` | `#059669` | Positive state indicators |
| `--cyn-color-warning` | `#f59e0b` | `#d97706` | Cautionary state indicators |
| `--cyn-color-danger` | `#ef4444` | `#dc2626` | Destructive action indicators |

### Radii Scale
- `--cyn-radius-sm`: `0.375rem` (6px)
- `--cyn-radius-md`: `0.5rem` (8px)
- `--cyn-radius-lg`: `0.75rem` (12px)
- `--cyn-radius-xl`: `1rem` (16px)
- `--cyn-radius-full`: `9999px` (Pill / Circular)

### Spacing Scale
- `--cyn-space-1`: `0.25rem` (4px)
- `--cyn-space-2`: `0.5rem` (8px)
- `--cyn-space-3`: `0.75rem` (12px)
- `--cyn-space-4`: `1rem` (16px)
- `--cyn-space-6`: `1.5rem` (24px)
- `--cyn-space-8`: `2rem` (32px)
- `--cyn-space-12`: `3rem` (48px)
- `--cyn-space-16`: `4rem` (64px)

### Liquid Glass Tokens
- `--cyn-glass-bg`: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)` (Dark) / `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)` (Light)
- `--cyn-glass-border`: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)`
- `--cyn-glass-blur`: `16px`
- `--cyn-glass-specular`: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7), transparent)`

### Touch Ergonomics Tokens (COH-AMD-1.4)
- `--cyn-touch-min`: `44px` (WCAG 2.2 Level AA target size)
- `--cyn-touch-comfortable`: `48px` (Ergonomic mobile target size)

## 5. Layout Recipes Reference

### `.stack`
Vertical layout primitive with uniform, non-collapsing gaps:
```css
@layer cyn.recipes {
  .stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .stack.gap-2 { gap: var(--cyn-space-2); }
  .stack.gap-4 { gap: var(--cyn-space-4); }
  .stack.gap-6 { gap: var(--cyn-space-6); }
}
```

### `.sidebar`
Adaptive sidebar layout that automatically collapses when content width drops below threshold:
```css
@layer cyn.recipes {
  .with-sidebar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--cyn-sidebar-gap, 1.5rem); }
  .sidebar { flex-basis: var(--cyn-sidebar-width, 16rem); flex-grow: 1; }
  .main-content { flex-basis: 0; flex-grow: 999; min-inline-size: 50%; }
}
```

### `.glass` and `.glass-edge`
Multi-tier optical glass recipe:
```css
@layer cyn.recipes {
  .glass {
    background: var(--cyn-glass-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--cyn-glass-border);
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--cyn-glass-blur));
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--cyn-glass-blur));
    border-radius: var(--cyn-radius-lg);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  }
  .glass-edge {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .glass-edge::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--cyn-glass-specular);
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
    .glass {
      background: var(--cyn-color-surface-elevated);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 6. Accessible Component Specifications

### Dialog (`component:dialog`)
- **Role**: `dialog` or `alertdialog`.
- **Invariants**:
  - `aria-modal="true"` required on container.
  - `aria-labelledby="<title-id>"` pointing to modal title heading.
  - Focus trap active: `Tab` and `Shift+Tab` cycle strictly inside the dialog.
  - Dismissal: `Escape` key closes dialog.
  - Focus restoration: On close, focus returns to trigger element.
  - Background scroll lock: `overflow: hidden` on `<body>` while dialog is open.

### Tabs (`component:tabs`)
- **Role**: `tablist` container containing `tab` buttons controlling `tabpanel` elements.
- **Invariants**:
  - Roving `tabindex`: Active tab has `tabindex="0"`; inactive tabs have `tabindex="-1"`.
  - Arrow navigation: `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` shifts focus and updates `tabindex`.
  - `aria-selected="true|false"` indicates active state.
  - `aria-controls="<panel-id>"` links tab to its associated tabpanel.

### Button (`component:button`)
- **Role**: Native `<button>` or element with `role="button"` and `tabindex="0"`.
- **Invariants**:
  - Keyboard activation on both `Enter` and `Space`.
  - Visible `:focus-visible` ring with 2px offset.
  - `aria-disabled="true"` when inactive (never remove focusability if tooltip or explanation is attached).

---

## 7. Motion & Physics Subsystem (`@coherynui/motion`)

### Analytical Harmonic Spring Solver
The spring engine implements the unforced second-order damped harmonic oscillator differential equation:

$$m \cdot \frac{d^2x}{dt^2} + c \cdot \frac{dx}{dt} + k \cdot x = 0$$

Where:
- $m$: Mass (default `1.0`)
- $k$: Stiffness (default `180.0`)
- $c$: Damping coefficient (default `14.0`)
- Damping ratio: $\zeta = \frac{c}{2 \sqrt{k \cdot m}}$
  - $\zeta < 1$: Underdamped (oscillates before settling)
  - $\zeta = 1$: Critically damped (fastest return to equilibrium without overshoot)
  - $\zeta > 1$: Overdamped (slow return without oscillation)

### FLIP Transitions (First, Last, Invert, Play)
Layout transitions compute bounding client rect differences between pre-mutation (`First`) and post-mutation (`Last`), apply negative transform offsets (`Invert`), and animate to zero using the spring solver (`Play`).

### Accessibility Contract
All `@coherynui/motion` animations must respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
```

---

## 8. GPU Materials & WebGPU Refraction Pipeline

### 3-Tier Fallback Hierarchy
1. **Tier 3 (WebGPU / WGSL)**: High-precision real-time chromatic aberration, normal map surface displacement, and dual-pass blur.
2. **Tier 2 (WebGL2)**: Fragment shader screen-space texture sampling fallback for browsers without WebGPU support.
3. **Tier 1 (CSS Liquid Glass)**: Pure CSS `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--cyn-glass-blur))` with hardware compositing.
4. **Reduced Transparency Fallback**: Opaque solid background (`--cyn-color-surface-elevated`) when `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce` is detected.

---

## 9. Compiler Diagnostics Matrix

| Code | Severity | Name | Description & Safe Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CY1001` | Warning | UnknownUtilityToken | Class does not exist in canonical registry. Verify spelling against `coherynui.config.toml` or declare in `@layer cyn.utilities`. |
| `CY1002` | Warning | DeprecatedToken | Token has been superseded. Replace with canonical replacement indicated in message. |
| `CY2001` | Error | MissingAriaContract | Interactive component lacks required ARIA attribute (`aria-labelledby`, `role`, etc.). |
| `CY2002` | Warning | LowContrastRatio | Foreground-to-background contrast is under WCAG 2.2 AA threshold (4.5:1 text, 3.0:1 UI). |
| `CY2003` | Error | FocusTrapMissing | Modal overlay lacks roving tabindex or focus trap boundary. |
| `CY2004` | Warning | TouchTargetUnder44px | Interactive element size is under 44px. Apply `.touch-target` to satisfy WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. |
| `CY3001` | Error | MissingShaderFallback | WebGPU shader material lacks Tier 1 CSS Liquid Glass fallback. |
| `CY3002` | Warning | MissingReducedMotion | Keyframe animation or spring transition lacks `prefers-reduced-motion` override. |

---

## 10. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Specifications

`coherynui mcp serve` implements the standard Model Context Protocol over stdio JSON-RPC.

### Read-Only Tools Catalog
1. `project_inspect`: Discovers installed packages, compiler version, active themes, and configuration roots.
2. `docs_search`: Semantic search over official version-matched documentation.
3. `components_search`: Search components by intent, category, framework, or capability.
4. `components_get`: Retrieves full API props, accessibility contracts, and verified code snippets for a component ID.
5. `recipes_search`: Search layout recipes (`stack`, `sidebar`, `glass`, etc.).
6. `themes_list`: Lists active design tokens, theme profiles, and custom overrides.
7. `styles_explain`: Explains CSS declarations and cascade layer resolution for input classes.
8. `code_validate`: Validates code snippet or file and returns structured diagnostics (`CYxxxx`).
9. `project_plan`: Generates component integration plan without touching project files.
10. `migration_analyze`: Reports migration mappings from legacy CSS frameworks to CoherynUI.

---

## 11. Coding Assistant Rules & Guardrails

When generating or editing code in a CoherynUI project, coding agents MUST follow these rules:

1. **Strict Prefix Usage**: Always use the canonical `cyn` prefix (`@layer cyn.*`, `--cyn-*`) unless a custom prefix is specified in `coherynui.config.toml`.
2. **Never Invent Utilities**: Do not invent ad-hoc non-standard classes (e.g. `p-[13px]`, `text-indigo-450`). Use canonical tokens or recipes.
3. **Enforce Layer Declarations**: When authoring styles, always wrap custom rules in the appropriate layer (`@layer cyn.recipes` or `@layer cyn.utilities`).
4. **Mandatory Accessibility**: Ensure every dialog has `aria-modal="true"`, buttons have discernible text or `aria-label`, and tabs implement roving tabindex.
5. **Always Validate**: After code changes, execute `coherynui check --format json` to ensure zero diagnostics.
6. **Zero External Runtime Mandate**: Do not import React, Motion, or GPU runtimes unless the user explicitly requested interactive React state or WebGPU effects.
